notes: The test peers are Python http.server processes that answer anyone; they stand in for hostile or outdated nodes and are not part of a node path.
The first run let the test peers live 9 s, and the second poll of r3 reached two of them after they had exited; they now live 20 s and every poll sees all four.
The tokens are SHA-256 hex of fixed test strings, for this gate only; their values are not recorded.
Every block was run as documented in fresh directories; no Node, NBB, JVM, hosted compiler, C compiler or C loader runs.
